Name: Boat Horse - Content Patcher
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Boat Horse[/size]
﻿
[size=6][img]https://i.imgur.com/29OIurw.gif[/img]

[/size][size=4]This mod replaces your horse with a boat. It also has an optional download to change Tractor Mod's tractor also into a boat.

To install: simply drag the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

To install the tractor replacement:
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod [/url]﻿first
[*]Drag the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and let it overwrite tractor.png.
[/list]
To uninstall the tractor replacement:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]Delete Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor.png[/size]
[*][size=4]Rename Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor_original.png to Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor.png[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by Pathoschild

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size]
